_comment_ComputerName: CUSTOMIZE: NetBIOS computer name (1 to 15 alphanumeric characters or hyphens, not all digits).
_comment_AuthorizedKey: CUSTOMIZE: Literal OpenSSH public key string (e.g. 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA... user@example.com'). Never paste a private key. Leave empty if AuthorizedKeyPath is used.
_comment_AuthorizedKeyPath: CUSTOMIZE: Path to a file containing an OpenSSH public key. Leave empty if AuthorizedKey is set.
_comment_AllowedRemoteAddresses: CUSTOMIZE: Allowed remote IPv4/IPv6 address scope or CIDR for OpenSSH firewall rule (e.g. '192.0.2.0/24' or 'Any').
_comment_DomainDnsTestName: CUSTOMIZE: Domain FQDN to test DNS resolution after bootstrap.
_comment_Restart: CUSTOMIZE: Set to true to automatically restart after successful bootstrap.
